name: @local/copilot-browser-agent
description: Cope: a guided terminal coding harness using Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat through a visible supported browser

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test:chromium-safety: npm run build && node scripts/run-tests-without-skips.mjs --manifest tests/chromium-safety-manifest.json
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=dist/src/orchestrator/agent-runtime.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/session/store.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/session/artifact-store.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/session/operation-journal.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/repository/checkpoint.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/repository/patch-engine.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/audit/audit-log.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/cli/session-recovery.js --test-coverage-include=dist/src/cli/setup-transaction.js --test-coverage-lines=70 --test-coverage-branches=60 --test-coverage-functions=70 --test --test-concurrency=1 dist/tests/unit/agent-runtime.test.js dist/tests/unit/audit.test.js dist/tests/unit/operation-journal.test.js dist/tests/unit/repository-patch.test.js dist/tests/unit/transport.test.js dist/tests/unit/session-recovery.test.js dist/tests/unit/cli-resume-recovery.test.js dist/tests/unit/cli-sessions.test.js dist/tests/unit/cli-onboarding.test.js dist/tests/unit/doctor-browser.test.js dist/tests/unit/setup-transaction.test.js dist/tests/reliability/critical-boundaries.test.js
scripts.check: npm run verify:release-version && npm run build && npm test
